actual_cloud_upload.scope: actual pre-submit CPU uploads, not GPU cloud-density readback

rain_source.shape: Camera-facing filled circle; screen radius at least0.75px. No velocity-dependent elongated footprint.
rain_source.dynamics: GPU Euler gravity/position/age; alive iff age<life. Existing previous-position fields are real particle positions.
rain_source.packed_fields: P.xyz0..2, radius3, actual_prev_P.xyz4..6, alpha7, RGB8..10, age11, motion_valid12
rain_source.motion_scope: Configured alpha0.4 means the existing alpha>=1 particle-MV branch is not selected; translucent rain deliberately retains surface MV and raises reactive. This is not classified as an MV bug.
rain_source.water_coupling: No rain collision/impact event enters the wave simulation; effects_lane.rs:772 only injects the authored initial drop at physicalstep0. Do not claim impact ripples.

cloud_visibility.confirmed_configuration_limit: Low slab30..90m uses default base/detail/weather scales3200/380/40000m, inherited from CloudParams default slab1500..4000m. Max cloud ray1000m. Host only overrides altitude/density/steps/maxdistance.
cloud_visibility.inference: A local street sky can cover only a small part of this large cloud field, so flat/haze-like appearance is plausible. Eight frames advance only7/60s and wind0.14/0.035m; near-static clouds are expected.
cloud_visibility.not_proven: No GPU cloud-density/coverage sample was retained here to establish flatness as a shader bug; no new cloud fix or scale candidate is selected in this task.

preferred_single_small_change.name: Particle-motion short shutter footprint for existing rain only
preferred_single_small_change.proposal: Project current P and actual_prev_P through the SAME CURRENT camera matrix, interpolate the endpoint for an explicit shutter fraction, and use a short swept-disc/capsule coverage. Do not use the previous-camera matrix for shape, so dolly/jitter does not create fake rain speed. motion_valid=false/newborn remains the current point.
preferred_single_small_change.coverage_energy: Treat it as exposure-normalized coverage, not a constant-alpha enlarged capsule. Preserve integrated coverage/energy approximately (e.g. area normalization for a first capsule approximation); explicitly disclose the approximation. Do not increase radiance, particle count or radius to manufacture visibility.
preferred_single_small_change.preserve: Existing actual per-fragment geometry visibility/air prefix, depth behavior, stable translucent surface MV, coverage/reactive and physicalstep lifecycle. No extra transport samples or new particle state.
variant_chain: camera_relative.rs::VARIANTS line13 / Plan::attach line134 -> hq_rain_sorted_surface_camera_relative_v1.rx (actual runtime name)
preferred_single_small_change.integration_note: Apply the same shape change to the generated base and derived surface/current camera-relative source while preserving the existing camera-ray block and its support binding. hq_spirv_camera_relative.py::adapt is a SPIR-V numeric adapter, not a source generator. No variant has been changed or compiled here.
preferred_single_small_change.limits: First approximation of shutter coverage at the existing depth plane, not a new refractive/drop scattering model; actual visibility improvement and brightness stability still need comparison before adoption.

one_to_two_second_existing_cli.simulation: Keep dt_s=1/60 and render all61/121 consecutive frames to reach physicalstep60/120 (~1/2s). --capture-every6/12 can save sparse frames0,6,...60 or0,12,...120.
one_to_two_second_existing_cli.capture_caveat: Remove scene,presented from --capture-sequence-stages when requesting sparse RAW; that option otherwise forces per-frame RAW. Retain scene_presented_v1 raw profile as desired.
one_to_two_second_existing_cli.frame_origin_caveat: --frame-origin changes sampling/camera index, not effects.step; it does not fast-forward rain/cloud lifecycle. No existing independent simulate-only stepping CLI was identified.
sources: core.rs:3655-3659 (capture behavior, independently checked by history_probe)
one_to_two_second_existing_cli.limit: Longer physical time costs more rendered frames. Sparse output is not sparse physical simulation and does not prove impact coupling or long-term cloud evolution.
